trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide:
Treat this as the audit at the end of the route, not a fifty-sixth objective. Earn every one of the other 54 trophies, including A Long Road for 100% Completion, then check for gaps by grade and kind in this tracker.

Before the final cleanup, leave a manual save with all remaining activities accessible. The platinum has no separate location or challenge in the official description; if it has not appeared, another base trophy is still missing.
trophies.progressCheck: 54 / 54 other trophies earned. This tracker’s checklist is useful for the audit; the console’s own trophy list is the final authority.

trophies.guide:
Prioritise Gone Fishing when it appears in the story route and finish the mission through its completion screen. Follow the current objective rather than detouring into side activities; the official condition is completion, not a particular score, time or approach.

No optional requirement is stated in the list. If the trophy does not appear, confirm that the mission actually ended instead of assuming that reaching its last objective was enough.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide:
Finish every required mission and transition belonging to Chapter 1. Continue until the story moves into Chapter 2; completing only the last active objective is not the same as closing the chapter.

Use this chapter break as a housekeeping point: make a manual save, then tick the trophy. The description gives no optional challenge or performance condition, so do not add one to your route.
trophies.progressCheck: Chapter 1 is complete and Chapter 2 has begun. There is no collectible or score requirement in the official trigger.

trophies.guide:
Advance the central story until Chapter 2 is fully complete and Chapter 3 starts. If you are using side missions for money or practice, return to the next main objective afterwards so the chapter does not remain open accidentally.

Keep a manual save at this second chapter break. That is route planning rather than an official requirement, but it gives you a clean return point for any named side work you postponed.
trophies.progressCheck: The story records Chapter 2 complete. Tick only on the chapter-completion unlock, not on starting its final mission.

trophies.guide:
Complete the remaining main-story chain for Chapter 3 and play into the transition to Chapter 4. The unlock condition is the chapter itself, so a mission replay or a high score is unnecessary unless the game separately asks for one to progress.

Before moving on, compare the chapter trophies already earned in this checklist. Catching a missing chapter milestone now is easier than diagnosing an incomplete platinum audit later.

Finish Chapter 4 by following its main objectives to the chapter close. Resist saving every open-world task for this point: named strands in Stage 2 of the roadmap should already be cleared or consciously scheduled before the finale.

The official text identifies chapter completion only. Any preparation, equipment or route suggestion here is practical planning, not an additional hidden unlock condition.

trophies.guide:
Complete Breakfast Run as soon as its mission strand is available, then confirm the mission end rather than leaving during a follow-up objective. Its official unlock is completion of that named mission, with no stated rating or collectible requirement.

This guide flags it as a cautious missable watch because it is a named side mission. That does not assert it becomes permanently unavailable; finishing before the finale simply removes the replay question.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide:
Reach 100% Completion after clearing the game’s required completion categories, not merely every trophy in this app. Trophy progress and game completion are different ledgers: the official condition explicitly asks for the latter.

Late in Stage 5, compare the in-game completion display with your remaining activity and collectible work, then finish the incomplete categories. Exactly which categories the game counts is not stated in the trophy description, so this guide does not invent a percentage formula.
trophies.progressCheck: The game itself reads 100% Completion. A full checklist here helps, but only the in-game percentage proves this gold trophy’s condition.

trophies.guide:
Build up 250 successfully recorded Stunts over the course of normal driving instead of leaving the whole counter to the end. Favour attempts you can land and repeat safely; a crash that is not registered as a completed stunt is not progress.

The official description gives a cumulative count and does not say 250 different stunt sites. Use the game’s own record to verify what registers before settling into a repeatable route. Any farming circuit is a preference, not an official requirement.

A silver or personal-best score is not a substitute for gold. Gold all 42 rather than completing 42 with mixed medals; the trophy’s wording makes medal quality and full coverage equally important.

Breaking pursuit or hiding briefly is not enough if the heat remains; wait until the escape is clearly complete. The approach is general series experience, while the 4 star, partner and escape conditions come from the official text.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide:
Set up five enemies in reach before activating Combat Focus, then take down all five during that single use. Starting the ability and searching for targets wastes the limited window; grouping targets first is the practical route.

The count resets when that use ends, so takedowns across two activations cannot be added together. The official condition does not prescribe a weapon or encounter, and this guide adds none.
trophies.progressCheck: 5 enemy takedowns inside one Combat Focus activation. If the effect ends at four, start a fresh five-target attempt.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide:
Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. The most cautious interpretation is to use an available non-routine way to leave rather than following a normal scheduled departure, but the official description does not define the exact accepted method.

Test one plausible departure method at a time and note the unlock. Vehicle type, route and destination are deliberately not fabricated; only VCIA and the unscheduled nature of the departure are explicit facts.
trophies.progressCheck: The trophy unlocks after an unscheduled VCIA departure. Because the trigger is vague, no invented flight number or fixed vehicle can serve as a checkpoint.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide:
Treat the Rhino clue as the lead: Rhino is the military tank name used in earlier Grand Theft Auto games, but this official description gives no required number or explicit action. Do not trust a made-up “destroy five tanks” instruction.

When a Rhino becomes available, make a manual save and test the obvious tank interactions separately—obtaining, using or escaping one—until the actual unlock resolves. Those are investigative hypotheses from series knowledge, not confirmed GTA VI steps.
trophies.progressCheck: Only the unlock confirms this vague trigger. The list supplies no tank count, location or mission name to track.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide:
Complete a jewelry store robbery without detection. Prepare an exit first, avoid the store’s detection conditions during the approach and robbery, and leave without an alert if the activity continues into an escape phase.

The condition is stealth, not a particular loot total or a no-damage rule. Unless the game’s own activity adds extra constraints, do not invent them. If detected, restart from a clean save before trying again.
trophies.progressCheck: One jewelry store robbery completes with no detection. A detected robbery followed by a successful police escape is not equivalent.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide:
Rob five Bank Vaults and escape after each required robbery. Maintain a five-entry log with a successful escape beside each vault; reaching the vault or taking its contents without getting away does not complete the whole wording.

The official text does not say five different banks or five in one session, so this guide does not impose those restrictions. Rely on the game’s counter to establish whether revisiting a bank adds credit.
trophies.progressCheck: 5 Bank Vault robberies each followed by escape. A vault entered without an escape remains unfinished for your log.

That interpretation is flagged because the official description does not name the activity or confirm whether both attempts must be consecutive. It is a purposeful first test, not a guaranteed hidden trigger.
